runtime.model_memory_query: aclmdlQuerySize is recorded for the active integrated OM; qwen35_dflash_om_inspect sums weights and uses the maximum serial workspace across a proposed multi-OM set
runtime.memory: persistent pinned host/device buffers; integrated input device mirrors upload only changed contiguous ranges after the first call and target D2H is limited to the last K+1 rows required by every current scheduler read; the four-OM runner packs prefill IDs, effective length, total prompt count, proposal count and EOS controls into one H2D carrier with 64-byte-aligned device subsegments per chunk, accumulates contiguous Target feature slabs in one device arena, and downloads only compact scheduler-visible results
runtime.synchronization: four-OM runner queues every non-final 64-row prompt chunk without compact D2H or host synchronization, completes the prompt once after the final chunk, and retains one synchronization per decode/verify transaction
runtime.execution_io_evidence: runner JSON records actual/full-equivalent H2D and D2H bytes, packed-control/decode/proposal copy counts, role executions, one completion per full prompt, elided intermediate-prefill D2H/synchronizations, and one synchronization per decode/verify transaction
runtime.incremental_performance_candidate: framework/abi/incremental-performance-v2.json is APPROVED_IN_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_ACTIVE; exact device-state implementation is authorized, while activation still requires export/ATC/parity/memory and same-device latency gates
runtime.incremental_transaction_tail: ExactAcceptCommitStateGraph uses fixed physical T=16, logical K=1..15, device-side longest-prefix acceptance, EOS truncation, scalar state selection and compact output
runtime.incremental_state_reset_candidates: async-memset clears one Target/Draft input state set inside first-prefill timing; immutable-zero initializes one extra read-only state set at process startup and removes per-request state clears; both preserve the v2 OM ABI and require same-device memory/latency selection
runtime.incremental_prefill_completion: non-final prompt chunks keep Target state and contiguous feature slabs ordered on one stream without executing Draft; a pinned-host staging slot per maximum 64-row chunk prevents asynchronous H2D source reuse, and only the final chunk executes one prebound dynamic-gear Draft, returns compact output and synchronizes
runtime.incremental_prefill_control: one carrier with AscendCL-compliant 64-byte-aligned device subsegments coalesces input IDs, effective length, total prompt count, proposal count, EOS IDs and EOS count into exactly one H2D per prompt chunk; strict report counters close every H2D operation and byte
runtime.incremental_device_suballocation: control, compact-result and Target/Draft state arenas reserve ALIGN_UP(payload,32)+32 bytes per segment and begin every segment at a 64-byte-aligned address

claim_boundary: Host and fake-ACL tests do not prove AIR export, OM conversion, physical 310P correctness, or latency. Those gates require the real locked target environment.
